events.text: White was appointed Adjutant General of Oregon.
events.subject: self
events.quote: White was appointed Adjutant General of Oregon on February 1 , 1915 .

events.text: White obtained a leave of absence to command a troop of Oregon cavalry.
events.subject: self
events.quote: he obtained a leave of absence in order to command a troop of Oregon cavalry

events.text: White's service on the Mexican border began.
events.subject: self
events.quote: After service on the Mexican border from June 1916 to February 1917

events.text: White's service on the Mexican border ended.
events.subject: self
events.quote: After service on the Mexican border from June 1916 to February 1917

events.text: White resumed his post in Oregon.
